# Imagine Products

> > Professional digital media workflow solutions for offloading, archiving, and sharing video content from acquisition to archive.

Imagine Products develops specialized software for media professionals including ShotPut Pro and ShotPut Studio for verified media offload, myLTO for LTFS-compliant LTO tape archiving, and TrueCheck for data integrity verification. Their solutions serve the film, video production, and post-production industries with both perpetual and rental licensing options for Mac and Windows platforms.

## Key Topics

- ShotPut Pro - verified media offload software
- ShotPut Studio - comprehensive media workflow automation
- myLTO - LTFS-compliant LTO tape archiving
- TrueCheck - data integrity verification
- PreRoll Post - media workflow solution
- digital media workflow and data management
- LTO archiving and tape backup solutions
- media offload with MHL support
- post-production workflow tools
- perpetual and rental licensing models
- Mac and Windows software platforms
- film and video production tools
- LTFS compliance and standards
- verified backup with checksum validation
- cloud upload integration
